observations: Photo 0 shows a black Dell OptiPlex 7060 desktop tower with a textured front panel, a Dell logo, and an Intel sticker at the bottom.
The front panel has a DVD drive, USB ports (including one blue USB 3.0), and audio jacks.
Photo 1 is a close-up of the Intel sticker on the front, clearly showing 'Intel Core i5 8th Gen'.
Photo 2 shows the rear panel with various ports: VGA, HDMI, multiple USB ports (including blue USB 3.0), Ethernet, audio jacks, and a power connector.
The rear panel also has a Windows sticker and a QR code sticker.
The unit appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and dust, but no visible damage.

claims.evidence: Photo 0: 'OptiPlex 7060' is clearly visible on the top front panel.
Photo 1: Intel sticker clearly reads 'CORE i5 8th Gen'.
No photo shows RAM sticks or BIOS/OS screen to confirm RAM amount. Cannot be verified from photos alone.
No internal drive bay or disk is visible. No BIOS/OS screen to confirm drive size. Cannot be verified from photos alone.
Photo 2 shows a Windows sticker, but it does not specify Windows 11 Pro. Could be Windows 10 or another version. No OS screen shown.

risks.proof: Photo of the open case showing RAM sticks, or a BIOS/OS screen showing installed RAM.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having less than 16GB RAM, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Hard drive is not 1TB or is faulty
risks.proof: Photo of the internal drive or a BIOS/OS screen showing drive size and health.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a smaller or non-functional drive, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Windows 11 Pro is not installed or is not genuine
risks.proof: Screenshot of the Windows OS showing version and activation status.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not having Windows 11 Pro, or as having a non-genuine license, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Unit is not functional or has internal damage
risks.proof: Video of the unit powering on, booting, and running a system check or benchmark.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, which drastically reduces value.

proof_requests: Photo of the open case showing RAM sticks and the hard drive.
Screenshot of the BIOS or Windows OS showing installed RAM, drive size, and Windows version.
Video of the unit powering on and booting into Windows.
response.reason: The model and processor are confirmed, but critical claims about RAM, storage, and OS cannot be verified from the photos. Hidden risks include incorrect specs or non-functionality, which must be proven before pricing.
